about: exp2250-r2's seven false or misleading cases (round 6, the tester's 5.1 to 5.7), seeded as walked tries (release 2's C5 (i)). Each seed is walked on the live pass at its tiers: the card opened (with a browser's key where it has a warm list: keys.js builds that key with the checkout's own factsCompute on a fresh browser worker that first builds the cards in warm, as the tester's browser had run other searches), the tries played and each frame read (verdict, reason, See it, the settled frames, Details, See why), and its Explore moves played after the card's answer. summary.py lists every claim each seed shows: on release 1 (f7e4c20) each case has a false or misleading one; after release 2 none may.
